2.120.46
ChartAxis.Visible
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartAxis.Visible element specifies whether to display a ChartAxis. The value of this element
MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String. This
element is optional. If the ChartAxis.Visible element is present, its value MUST be one of the
following:
Auto: Specifies that the axis is displayed if it is in use (such as if a series is plotted against it, or if it
has the ChartAxis.ChartAxisTitle element specified).
True: Specifies that the axis is displayed.
False: Specifies that the axis is hidden.
If the ChartAxis.Visible element is not present, its value is interpreted as "Auto".
Following is the parent element of the ChartAxis.Visible element.
Parent elements
ChartAxis
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartAxis.Visible element.
 <xsd:element name="Visible" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
